source: Raw XML exported by 1C 8.3.27.2074 from isolated infobases after parent and extension import, check and apply. Both extension descriptors were imported and exported through a second independently created infobase and retained byte-exact.

extension-enum-value.xml.source: Исходный экспорт расширения после живого цикла ibcmd 8.3.27.2074; фиксирует канонический EnumValue с BOM и CRLF (#1396).

extension-common-module.xml.source: Raw platform export after importing CommonModule.Server=false with PropertyState Server/Notify; byte-exact after a second independent infobase import/export.

parent-common-module.xml.source: Raw platform export of the isolated parent configuration used for the CommonModule.Server/Notify probe.

extension-common-module-inherited.xml.source: Raw platform export of an adopted CommonModule imported with only ObjectBelonging, Name, Comment and ExtendedConfigurationObject: none of the eight CommonModule properties is written; the platform added only PropertyState Module/Extended for the extension module. Byte-exact after a second independent infobase import/export (#1304).

extension-common-module-environment-only.source: Raw platform export of an adopted CommonModule imported with the six environment flags but without Privileged and ReturnValuesReuse; the platform keeps exactly that set. Byte-exact after a second independent infobase import/export (#1304).

parent-common-module-cache.xml.source: Raw platform export of the parent CommonModule adopted by extension-common-module-inherited.xml; its Privileged=true and ReturnValuesReuse=DuringRequest are not copied into the extension descriptor (#1304).

extension-role-inherited.xml.source: Raw platform export of an adopted Role imported without Ext/Rights.xml: no rights file is exported, the platform adds only PropertyState Rights/Extended (#1381).

extension-common-form-inherited.xml.source: Raw platform export of an adopted CommonForm imported without Ext/Form.xml: no form file is exported, the platform adds only PropertyState Form/Extended (#1381).

extension-data-processor.xml.source: Raw platform export of an adopted DataProcessor whose adopted form and two adopted templates carry no payload files (#1381).

extension-object-form-inherited.xml.source: Raw platform export of an adopted object form imported without Ext/Form.xml; same shape as the adopted CommonForm (#1381).

extension-template-spreadsheet-inherited.source: Raw platform export of an adopted object template imported without TemplateType and Ext/Template.xml: the platform writes TemplateType SpreadsheetDocument and no template body (#1381).

extension-template-schema-inherited.xml.source: Raw platform export of an adopted DataCompositionSchema template imported with TemplateType but without Ext/Template.xml (#1381).

extension-common-template-inherited.xml.source: Raw platform export of an adopted CommonTemplate imported without Ext/Template.xml (#1381).

extension-xdto-package-inherited.xml.source: Raw platform export of an adopted XDTOPackage imported without Namespace and Ext/Package.bin: neither is exported (#1381).
